problem: For every neighborhood of an equilibrium, all trajectories starting sufficiently close remain inside that neighborhood for all future time. Non-equilibrium trajectories starting arbitrarily close do not converge to the equilibrium as time increases; they may oscillate or circle around it. How should the equilibrium be classified?

choices.value: Asymptotically stable only for nonlinear systems.
Asymptotically stable only for certain initial conditions.

activity_context.topic_title: Equilibrium Points and Stability for Systems of ODEs
